security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Convert legacy Bangla text to Unicode.
bundle.longDescription: Converts legacy Bijoy and SutonnyMJ Bangla into Unicode, word by word, leaving English, numbers and existing Unicode Bengali exactly as they were. Works entirely offline.
